fixture.pathPolicy: All manifest paths must be slash-separated local paths below the repository root and must not cross symlinks.

surfaces.unsupportedReason: gofly formats one explicit API file while pinned goctl traverses and rewrites a directory, and neither CLI exposes the same parse-only boundary.

surfaces.equivalence: Both prebuilt CLIs may generate Go REST output from the same copied .api fixture and the same fresh minimal go.mod scaffold; a runtime preflight must downgrade this row to unsupported if either parser or generation boundary differs.

surfaces.unsupportedReason: gofly emits OpenAPI 3.0.3 while pinned goctl exposes a Swagger command that emits Swagger 2.0, so the document-generation contracts are not equivalent.
Pinned goctl has no OpenAPI v3 generator or output flag equivalent to gofly OpenAPI 3.0.3 export.

crossFrameworkLatency.reason: Shared hosted runners are noisy, and unlike-framework process latency is not a release blocker during initial governance.

failureModes: Reject a mutable or mismatched goctl oracle revision.
Reject absolute, parent-traversing, or symlink-crossing fixture paths.
Build gofly and goctl once per run and execute commands without a shell.
Downgrade REST generation to unsupported when either CLI rejects the fixture or the fresh scaffold boundaries differ.
Fail on any admitted REST command non-zero exit without swallowing output.
Keep unsupported surfaces out of benchmark execution and classify them explicitly.
Reject publishable evidence with fewer than ten alternating samples.
Allow exactly one sample only in non-publishable smoke mode.
Require exactly 27 gofly benchmark rows with at least ten samples for publishable evidence.
Keep cross-framework latency report-only while allowing explicit gofly REST-generation allocation budgets to block.
